nodes.name: Agent Created Webhook
nodes.notes: Before activating: create/select a Header Auth credential whose header name is x-mindflow-secret and whose value matches N8N_AGENT_WEBHOOK_SECRET in the MindFlow backend .env. Production URL: https://<n8n-host>/webhook/mindflow-agent-created

parameters.responseBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ received: true, agentId: $('Validate & Normalize').first().json.agentId, event: $('Validate & Normalize').first().json.event, executionId: $execution.id, receivedAt: $('Validate & Normalize').first().json.receivedAt }) }}
={{ JSON.stringify({ received: false, error: $('Validate & Normalize').first().json.error || 'invalid payload' }) }}
